tool_args.rationale: The prior model attempt failed because it referenced an undefined training-row global. Fit the three documented base-siphon parameters numerically using all seven rows, within the supplied wide fallback bounds; prediction now uses the fitted parameters without relying on harness-specific globals.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch probe already added two rows spanning s_grad 0.18 to 2.35; the remaining failure was a code NameError, not a lack of identifying data.
The measured maximum s_grad is 2.35, below the documented >2.36 threshold-probe condition; no avalanche evidence is present.
The observed response is monotone-concave over u_now and the broad-gradient observations support the documented siphon base, not a high-u decline.
